symptom: mendixlabs/mxcli#1399: on the FSM template (Mendix 9.24.2) `check --references` refused native snippets' nested repeaters and actions with CE1571 (a nanoflow data source/action "has no argument for parameter 'NativeInstanceItem'"), read as a missing argument mapping. The mapping is empty in the source too — Mendix infers it from the enclosing repeater — but describe printed that repeater with no DataSource at all, so the nested widgets had no context object.
cause: Studio Pro 9's pluggable "Database" source is CustomWidgets$CustomWidgetDatabaseSource (simple Forms$DatabaseConstraint rows, an IndirectEntityRef path, a sort bar). parseDataSource did not know the type; the generic pluggable reader (namedCustomWidgetDataSources) then dropped the unsupported result because it filters on Reference != "", so not even the `no MDL spelling` comment appeared. The start parameter of the path is on the WidgetValue on 9.x (EntityPathSource.sourceVariable is 10.0+), so reading the datasource alone also gave $currentObject. No writer existed, and `database from $ctx/…` was refused off a list view.
file: mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_datasource.go (parseCustomWidgetDatabaseSource, rows rendered as XPath); mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_pluggable.go (withWidgetValueSourceVariable; keep Unsupported); mdl/executor/pluggable_database_source.go (9.x gate, rows parsed back); mdl/backend/modelsdk/widget_write.go (customWidgetDatabaseSourceToGen); mdl/backend/widgetobj/builder.go (WidgetValue SourceVariable)
insight: `mx convert` with a newer mxbuild is a measuring instrument: 10.12.19 rewrote all ten of the template's CustomWidgetDatabaseSources into CustomWidgetXPathSources, which both settled the version gate (the type is 9.x-only) and gave the canonical XPath for the constraint rows ([IsActive and ReasonType!='x']). The type looked unused because nothing on 10/11 test apps has it. And a filter on `Reference != ""` silently swallows Unsupported results — the one result shape whose whole purpose is to be seen.
